tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Identify the account, user, and credential behind this connection, with plan, credit balance, rate limits, and the tools available. Only needed to troubleshoot the connection or check credits and limits — other tools already act on this account.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: List what a script can call: the Crevio API (crevioApi), Crevio's own tools (platform), and every integration you can use, each as a namespace under `tools`, plus the account's other connected apps and their status. Then list a namespace's functions with list_integration_tools.

tools.name: list_integration_tools
tools.description: List one namespace's functions — the name a script calls, its parameters, whether it only reads, whether it needs approval, and a snippet run_script accepts. crevioApi has hundreds of operations: narrow it with `search`.

tools.name: run_script
tools.description: Run JavaScript on the account's computer with bun — no agent turn — and wait for its result. `tools.<namespace>.<function>(args)` calls anything list_integration_tools shows (every call returns its result and throws on failure; top-level await works), and the script's last expression is its result.

tools.name: wait_for_script_run
tools.description: Wait for a script run to finish and return its result. If it is still running when the wait ends, the reply has wait_timed_out: true — call again. A finished run whose calls wait for approval asks for them here when this client can show a form.

tools.name: get_script_run
tools.description: Read a script run's status, and its result once it has finished.

tools.name: cancel_script_run
tools.description: Cancel a script run that has not started yet. A running script runs to its end or its timeout.

tools.name: ask_crevio
tools.description: Delegate a job to the Crevio agent and wait for the result. The agent works your account through the Crevio API and every connected integration (products, customers, orders, email, socials, sites, research) and replies in `result`. Each job is a full agent run that takes from half a minute to severa

tools.name: start_chat
tools.description: Open a chat with the Crevio agent and queue a run, without waiting. Returns the run immediately. Its `chat_id` is the conversation to continue with send_message, but it stays null until the run starts; send_message takes the run id in its place. Follow the run with wait_for_run or get_run.

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: List the account's chats, newest first.

tools.name: get_chat
tools.description: Get a chat's title, kind, and latest run.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Continue a chat with follow-up instructions or answers — the agent keeps its context. Resumes a run waiting in needs_input, or queues a new run when the last one finished. Returns run_busy while a run is still in progress. Optionally waits for the reply.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Read a chat's messages, oldest first. Returns the most recent `limit` messages; page back through older ones with ending_before.

tools.name: wait_for_run
tools.description: Wait for a run to settle (completed, failed, cancelled, or needs_input) and return it with the agent's final reply. If it is still running when the wait ends, the reply has wait_timed_out: true — call wait_for_run again.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Fetch a run's current status, summary, pending approvals, and (once settled) the agent's final reply.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: List the account's task runs, newest first — delegated jobs and scheduled tasks alike. Filter by status, task, or chat.

tools.name: resolve_approvals
tools.description: Approve or deny actions waiting for a decision. With run_id: a run in needs_input; decide every one of its pending_approval_ids at once and it resumes in the background. Without run_id: approvals a script run or the API raised; each approved one runs its frozen call now and the reply carries its out

tools.name: cancel_run
tools.description: Stop a run that is pending, running, or waiting for input, and its media generations still in flight. A run mid-step finishes that step first: it returns with cancel_requested_at set and settles as cancelled moments later (wait_for_run to confirm). Repeating it while the run stops is harmless; once

tools.name: get_file_download_url
tools.description: Exchange an artifact id (art_...) from a run's or script run's `artifacts` for a download link. The link needs no credentials and expires after 15 minutes; ask again for a fresh one.

tools.name: list_audit_events
tools.description: List the account's audit events, newest first: access and configuration changes, approvals, API key use, and (at the full capture level) the agent's tool calls.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "run_script" is 1373 chars, far longer than this server's median (220). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "run_script" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_file_download_url" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_crevio, start_chat, list_chats, get_chat, list_messages, list_runs, get_file_download_url · Private data: whoami, run_script, get_file_download_url, list_audit_events · Public sink: ask_crevio, send_message · Destructive: run_script, wait_for_script_run, get_script_run, cancel_script_run, ask_crevio, start_chat, get_chat, send_message, wait_for_run, get_run, resolve_approvals, cancel_run, get_file_download_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_crevio, start_chat, list_chats, get_chat, list_messages, list_runs, get_file_download_url · Private data: whoami, run_script, get_file_download_url, list_audit_events · Public sink: ask_crevio, send_message · Destructive: run_script, wait_for_script_run, get_script_run, cancel_script_run, ask_crevio, start_chat, get_chat, send_message, wait_for_run, get_run, resolve_approvals, cancel_run, get_file_download_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
